description: This file defines the LoginPage class for automating interactions with the OrangeHRM login page using Selenium WebDriver, implementing page object pattern methods such as open(), login(), and validation checks.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Represents the login page of OrangeHRM for UI test automation, providing methods to perform login actions and validate UI elements.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Navigates to the login page URL.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Fills in the username and password fields and submits the login form.

methods.name: isInvalidCredentialsShown
methods.description: Checks if the invalid credentials notification is visible.

methods.name: isRequiredShown
methods.description: Checks if the 'Required' message is visible.
